title: TAO AutoML best_rec
description: The read side of the AutoML -> downstream (e.g. DEFT warm-start) seam emitted by the tao-run-automl step engine. DEFT's own loop state stays in deft_state.json.

metric_name.description: Explicit metric identity (e.g. far_at_100_recall, val_loss) — a bare number without name+direction is a contract violation.

specs.description: The winning HPs as a NESTED dict with budget keys (num_epochs etc.) STRIPPED — ASHA/hyperband mutate the budget per rung, and a rung budget deep-merged into a baseline spec silently overwrites the real epoch count.

observed_budget.description: The budget the winning trial actually ran at (e.g. {"num_epochs": 10}), kept SEPARATE from specs.

job_id.description: Directly names .tao/jobs/<id>.json; a derived downstream job may reference it through parent_job.
